## Overview

This course covers the essential mathematical and computing skills needed to study modern economics. It reviews differential and integral calculus—including derivatives, optimization, and integration—as well as introductory data analysis in Excel and R.

## Topics

::: {.topic-tags}

[Functions and derivatives]{.topic-tag}
[Logs and exponents]{.topic-tag}
[Unconstrained optimization]{.topic-tag}
[Constrained optimization]{.topic-tag}
[Lagrange multipliers]{.topic-tag}
[Consumer theory]{.topic-tag}
[Implicit functions]{.topic-tag}
[Elasticities]{.topic-tag}
[Slutsky equation]{.topic-tag}
[Producer theory]{.topic-tag}
[Excel]{.topic-tag}
[R]{.topic-tag}

:::
